verified_deadlock.assumptions: Pinned headless V2, four switches OFF, no StallWatchdog or external interventions.
verified_deadlock.proof: Every movement alternative requires at least one stationary member to release a node or stable merge admission first. Mutable/idle vehicles include every outgoing edge. Thus no member can be first to move under the modelled transitions.
verified_deadlock.reproduction: same sampled state history and revalidated proof

limitations: Cycle episode log is occupancy/follow only; mixed-set proofs are in verification.jsonl.
Mutable vehicles with an unproved escape remain unresolved; no claim of complete detection.
T is first sampled cycle state, t_confirm is persistence threshold, neither proves deadlock.
One-second sampled state, not restartable engine state or a complete event trace.
Active episodes at end are right-censored; dependency loss is not proof of recovery.
